name: Two-story house with 3-car garage (PDF)

parts.name: two_story_house_plans.pdf p1 d1
parts.note: This sheet has 4 drawings and no text to tell them apart: look at each one first. A floor plan is seen from above (rooms, walls, doors); an elevation or section is the house seen from the side (roof, ground line, floor heights) and makes no floor, but gives heights. Say in each floor's frame which drawing it came from. Overview of drawing 1 of the 4 on two_story_house_plans.pdf (frame D1.1): cut out of the sheet (it covers about 5% of the sheet) and drawn sharp, 2400 x 1717 px. Its pixels are frame D1.1: x right, y down, top-left is (0, 0). 2 close-ups of it follow; read the details (walls, doors, fixtures, small text) from them. The PDF has no text here (its words are drawn as lines), so read the words off the pictures.
